findings.text: Prompt card question types at about 4 characters a second; 25 s is a near-empty frame.
Chat card crowds the mark tile (standard rule 3).
'Shall I pay the deposit' types at about 5 characters a second.
BLOCKED stamps before the reply finishes typing.
Every STAGE beat leaves the lower 55 percent empty except one word.
style.motion is unset, so the cut falls back to house motion.
brand title shows only on one face beat; the reference holds it throughout, and the serif switches mid-sentence on non-emphasis words.
OCR misreads short words on face beats; cause unproven.

references.note: one white heavy word at chest height off the face under a yellow title on face shots. Misses: face only 11 of 47.5 s; title not held; serif switches mid-sentence
rounded cards on a pale wash, logo orbit, face-below splits. Misses: cards off-centre, no glow, lower half empty, about 15 cuts a minute against 30, slow typing
